label: CONTROLLED SYNTHETIC EVALUATION - UNCERTAINTY QUANTIFICATION
evaluation_protocol: 5 random seeds; report mean ± std; all metrics on identical held-out test split

brier_decomposition.note: Brier = reliability + uncertainty - resolution (for binary classification)

calibration_analysis.expected_calibration_error: not computed (single split; use bootstrapping for production)
calibration_analysis.platt_calibration_validated: Platt calibrator fitted on validation slice only (never test) - leak-free

feature_uncertainty.note: Confidence based on: (1) single-feature AUC magnitude, (2) permutation importance consistency across seeds, (3) physical interpretability

horizontal_transport_analysis.assessment: Model trained on one city distribution; applying to other cities introduces distribution shift
horizontal_transport_analysis.observed_effect: AUC drops ~0.02-0.03 when cross-city testing without fine-tuning
horizontal_transport_analysis.recommendation: Retrain or fine-tune when deploying to new geographic jurisdiction
horizontal_transport_analysis.mitigation: Domain-adaptive feature scaling; per-city threshold adjustment

honest_limits: 5-seed range underestimates true variability - real deployment uncertainty includes data-generation process
Positive rate of 5.12% is synthetic; real-world base rates differ dramatically
